== Build notes ==
* Built 13 October 2026 from the SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 (sealed specs, rarity, misprints, errors, Executive Gift Set, oversized cards), plus dated price sources for the pricing timeline (Potomac Distribution 2009, Quiet Speculation 2020, VGCultureHQ 2021, hobbyDB 2024, PriceCharting eBay sold listings 2025–2026). [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 17:45, 13 October 2026 (UTC)

== Missing data ==
* No sourced price data found for 1996–2008 (period price guides such as ''Scrye'' or ''InQuest'' were not available online). The pricing timeline starts in 2009.
* PriceCharting (Coruscant and Cloud City booster boxes) blocks Wayback: two save attempts on 13 October 2026 returned HTTP 520, and direct requests get 403. The refs say "Preserved copy: none". A swccg.com snapshot (route C) would fix this.
* No wiki page yet for the Executive Gift Set, Japanese Hoth, the Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game, or Promotional foils, so these are unlinked.

== Possibly faulty data ==
* The 2021 "$300" top card and the "$500 to over $2,000" boxes come from one blogger (VGCultureHQ), who doesn't say which card or which sets.

== Inferences (not in article text) ==
* ''Inferred:'' late-set premiums (Coruscant boxes sell for about six times as much as Cloud City boxes in 2025–2026) follow from the smaller late print runs that Potomac and Quiet Speculation describe. No print-run figures from Decipher were found.

== Marginal cuts ==
* hobbyDB 2024 also lists Corellian Corvette at $730, but doesn't say which printing (it could be the 2000 DecipherCon promo foil), so it was left out.
* A 2022 r/starwarsccg thread (x3kw5l) says chase cards rose 300–400% during the pandemic. This is forum opinion, so it was left out.

* No wiki pages for A New Hope Revised, Hoth Revised, Dagobah Revised (left unlinked). [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 18:13, 13 October 2026 (UTC)

== Current prices (rev 83387) ==
* Each value is the most recent single-price sold listing on the PriceCharting page (eBay), read 13 October 2026; sale date shown in the cell. Listings showing two prices (struck/offer) were skipped in favour of the newest single-price sale.
* PriceCharting has no page for Premiere Limited/Unlimited, Hoth, Jabba's Palace, Revised ANH/Hoth, Endor, Reflections I–III, Tatooine, Theed Palace boxes/packs, or any Anthology, Two-Player Game or Sealed Deck; those cells are blank. Enhanced Cloud City 'sealed box' page (last sale 2024, product unclear) not used.
* Snapshots of the 15 PriceCharting pages are awaiting hosting at swccg.com/snapshots/prices/ and Wayback capture. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 18:44, 13 October 2026 (UTC)
